posts.title: Geely takes on BYD with system charging EVs to 70% in 4.5 minutes
posts.summary:
Geely's system took just 4 minutes and 30 seconds to charge from 10% to 70% in real-world tests, beating BYD's 5 minutes.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Geely has launched a new AI-powered charging system that achieves a 10% to 70% charge in just 4 minutes and 30 seconds, outperforming BYD's 5-minute benchmark.
The fifth-generation Geely Smart Charging Station delivers a peak power of 2,250 kW, significantly exceeding the 1,500 kW capacity of BYD's current flash charging piles.

The system utilizes the 'Xingrui PowerMind' AI model to coordinate vehicle, battery, and grid data, while a five-point liquid cooling system manages thermal performance across the entire charging chain.
To mitigate battery degradation concerns associated with ultra-fast charging, Geely has integrated lithium-ion pulse restoration technology.

posts.title: BYD Denza launches Z9S electric sedan with range of up to 1,100 km
posts.summary:
The Denza Z9S starts at 255,800 yuan ($37,910), 64,000 yuan lower than its pre-sales price.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: BYD's premium brand Denza launched the Z9S electric sedan with a starting price of 255,800 yuan, which is 64,000 yuan lower than its initial pre-sale price.
The flagship variant offers a CLTC range of 1,100 km, which Denza claims is a new global record for mass-produced all-electric vehicles.
The performance variant features a tri-motor AWD system with 890 kW of power, enabling acceleration from 0 to 100 km/h in 2.68 seconds.
The vehicle integrates BYD's second-generation Blade Battery and 'God's Eye 5.0' system, which utilizes reinforcement learning and end-to-end large models for advanced navigation assistance.

								By: Arteris
								
							
						
Modern semiconductor systems have reached unprecedented levels of complexity.
Today’s system-on-chip (SoC) architectures integrate hundreds of heterogeneous IP blocks, multiple compute engines, shared memory hierarchies, and extensive firmware and software stacks.
While these capabilities enable powerful computing platforms, including AI and machine learning, they also expand the hardware attack surface deep into the silicon architecture.

With this eBook, you will learn how to:
- Detect vulnerabilities early in the development lifecycle.
